shortlist.fact: The Anglo-Zanzibar War of 27 August 1896, between the United Kingdom and the Sultanate of Zanzibar, lasted 38 to 45 minutes, the shortest recorded war in history.
shortlist.why: It's about Zanzibar, it's a war that lasted less time than my lunch break, and I've literally never heard anyone say this.
shortlist.title: Anglo-Zanzibar War
shortlist.claim: Tanzania hosted the shortest war in recorded history, the Anglo-Zanzibar War between the British Empire and the Sultanate of Zanzibar, which lasted only 38 to 45 minutes in 1896.

alternates.fact: In 1967 a Masai tribesman found intense violet-to-blue crystals in Merelani, northern Tanzania, sparking the tanzanite mining boom.
alternates.why: I know tanzanite is ours and that it comes from Mererani, but I could never have said who actually found the first crystals or when — a Masai tribesman in 1967 is not the story I was taught.
alternates.title: Tanzanite History and Lore
alternates.claim: Tanzanite is a striking blue-violet gemstone found exclusively in the Merelani Hills of northern Tanzania, making it roughly 1,000 times rarer than a diamond.

candidate.fact: In 1967 a Masai tribesman found intense violet-to-blue crystals in Merelani, northern Tanzania, sparking the tanzanite mining boom.
